_comment: TESTNET short-dated listing written for scripts/testnet-markets.sh, which fills settlement.primary.feed with the TestnetPushFeed it deploys (a Chainlink-compatible feed the keeper updates from Pyth every 5 minutes; testnet Chainlink has no MON/USD feed and updates ETH/USD too rarely for 1-6 h expiries). Settlement through it trusts the keeper: testnet only. asset = Kuru's testnet USDC 0x3bA3...1570 (6 decimals; docs.kuru.io), so every option can have a Kuru book. strikeStepWad and contractSizeWad are read by script/testnet/RollShortSeries.s.sol. underlying = WMON 0xFb8b...C541 (monad-crypto testnet token list). The asset is approved by the WETH listing, so approveAsset is false here.
